title: Modular interpretation of the Weil-Petersson metric asymptotics for abelian varieties
summary: As a first step towards a refined description of the asymptotic of the Weil-Petersson metric on the moduli space of polarized Calabi-Yau manifolds we investigate the concrete case of abelian varieties by linking such asymptotic with the multi-scale collapsing limits of the parametrized flat tori, as explicitly classified by Odaka.
